voice-routing-compatibility.rationale: SetSend/ClearSend change routing structure and are explicit exceptions, not ordinary level controls.
voice-routing-compatibility.consumer_contract: Existing Voice.SetSend/ClearSend and native equivalents; VOICE_WRAPPER_CONTRACT and repository consumer tests retain both. No deployed production consumer dependency is asserted.

voice-routing-compatibility.retirement_condition: Remove from the default game SDK only after an equivalent authored routing path is implemented and validated and all identified consumers have a documented migration; report the exception in releases until then.

native-tooling.rationale: Authoring, raw content registration, topology/effect/binding edits and deep capture do not belong to the default game API.
native-tooling.consumer_contract: Complete native ABI remains available to Studio Preview, Remote and engine tooling; U3 excludes these from game headers.

native-tombstones.rationale: Preserve retired numeric protocol entries without republishing deleted ABI functions.
native-tombstones.consumer_contract: Existing wire table public=false entries; keep public/opcode/policy unchanged.

native-binding.rationale: The full P/Invoke projection is an SDK implementation detail, including public constants and overloads.
native-binding.consumer_contract: HarkenNative generated by gen_binding.py; Harken.Unity and Harken.Unity.Editor already have precise friend access.

runtime-internals.rationale: SDK coordination, counters, test hooks and utility implementation are not game contracts.
runtime-internals.consumer_contract: VariableGameplay, VariableCatalogGuard, Utf8, generated ABI checker and internal integration helpers; preserve their existing internal consumers.

runtime-tools.rationale: Move authoring/catalog generation, full snapshots and broad engine mutation helpers behind explicit tool access.
runtime-tools.consumer_contract: SDK Editor, catalog generation and native tool consumers; generated code must be changed through its generator in U2.

editor-tools.rationale: Explicit Editor assembly tools remain available to game editor integrations, without entering the Player game contract.
editor-tools.consumer_contract: Harken.Unity.Editor public preview, waveform, catalog, settings and inspectors.

tool-types.rationale: Types used only by the complete tool ABI are not automatically public game DTOs.
tool-types.consumer_contract: Full native declarations/wire table remain authoritative; U2 retains required public type closure. VnConstants is classified per member: Monitor/Snapshot formats and limits, effect/curve capacities, staged Voice install and internal variable-batch capacity remain tool vocabulary.

suspended-publication-signatures.rationale: Keep declarations required by suspended Editor workflows without retaining legacy Pack readers, validators or migration.
suspended-publication-signatures.consumer_contract: Paused Editor catalog/preview signatures. Legacy publication capture/read/validation rejects with VN_PACK_INCOMPATIBLE; no files or readers are consumed.
suspended-publication-signatures.retirement_condition: Replace these declarations when Editor tools consume current Pack companions, or remove the suspended API surface.
